facts.text: Undergraduates can spend a semester at The Second City in Chicago studying comedy writing, performance, and improvisation full time for college credit.

sources.title: Experiential Learning | Columbia College Chicgo
sources.quote: You'll study performance, comedy writing and improvisation full time at the Second City Training Center in Chicago for college credit at Columbia.

facts.text: Through the Semester in LA program, Columbia students spend a semester living and studying on a historic studio lot in Los Angeles while earning their degree.

sources.title: Experiential Learning | Columbia College Chicgo
sources.quote: Our one-of-a-kind multidisciplinary program is led by industry insiders and held on a historic studio lot.
